title: Quality & GD&T AI — Tolerancing, Metrology & CMM Intelligence

units.title: 16 Quality & GD&T AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 QUALITY-GDT-AI domains: gdt_datum_structure (datum reference frame, datum precedence A/B/C, datum targets), gdt_position (true position calculation, bonus tolerance, virtual condition), gdt_profile (profile of a surface/line, all-around/all-over, unequal bilateral), gdt_runout (circular runout vs total runout, coaxiality vs runout relationship), gdt_flatness (flatness verification, sampling strategies, reference plane fitting), gdt_perpendicularity (perpendicularity to datum, tangent plane modifier), gdt_parallelism (parallelism to datum plane/axis, straightness relationship), gdt_concentricity (median point coaxiality, symmetry vs concentricity), gdt_mmc_lmc (MMC/LMC/RFS modifiers, bonus tolerance calculation, functional gauging), gdt_tolerance_stack (worst-case and RSS stack-up analysis, loop diagrams), gdt_measurement_strategy (sampling density, measurement uncertainty, probe path planning), gdt_cmm_programming (DMIS programming, Calypso/PC-DMIS alignment, auto-reporting), gdt_gauge_design (attribute vs variable gauges, go/no-go gauge tolerancing), gdt_uncertainty (GUM methodology, Type A/B uncertainty, expanded uncertainty), gdt_capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk per AIAG MSA, gauge R&R), gdt_drawing_interpretation (title block, tolerance notes, ASME Y14.5-2018 symbols)

standards: GUM — Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement

summary: Complete Quality and GD&T AI intelligence with 16 domains covering datum reference frames, position and true position with bonus tolerance, profile of surface/line, runout (circular and total), flatness, perpendicularity, parallelism, concentricity, MMC/LMC/RFS modifiers, tolerance stack-up analysis (worst-case and RSS), CMM measurement strategy, DMIS/PC-DMIS/Calypso CMM programming, gauge design, GUM measurement uncertainty, process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk/MSA), and drawing interpretation per ASME Y14.5-2018. Deep expertise from ASME Y14.5-2018, ISO 1101, AIAG MSA, metrology PDFs, and CMM programming references.
